semantics.receiver: locked GBN exact-next byte sequence; L2BackToZero=false
semantics.accepted: sum of contiguous protocol-accepted bytes per message; excludes duplicates and discarded out-of-order data
semantics.unique_arrival: byte-range union of physical destination arrivals; may include discarded out-of-order data
semantics.timestamps: simulated ns; MacRx before receiver acceptance at the same ns; not GPU-visible timestamps
semantics.model_bytes: native packet size including modeled headers; excludes unmodeled Ethernet preamble/FCS/IFG
semantics.scope: generated graphs only if failed; future ungenerated waves are not included; evaluation-only association
